title: Waging Good Warfare with the Prophetic Word
description: This week on The River Church of Kansas City podcast, Pastor Chris Zehner shares a timely message on the importance of understanding and navigating prophetic words, highlighting the need for spiritual maturity and discernment in the face of spiritual warfare. Learn how to distinguish between God's leading and the enemy's schemes, and discover the peace and freedom that comes with trusting in God's sovereignty. Don't miss this practical and inspiring message from Pastor Chris!
